notes: Printer Bot 3.2.1 lets test prints show real Twitch viewers. In the Test card a Twitch event has one Twitch name box: type a viewer's name, and the test prints their profile picture. Check beside the box tells you first whether the name is on Twitch and shows the picture, and after a test print the dock says whether the names it used were found. Names are looked up at decapi.me, as for every receipt. A Brother VC-500W printer also gets Maximum sticker length (mm): a High Roller sticker that would be longer is fitted to it, its pictures smaller first, then its message cut. From 2.5.0 on, this version needs no new import; an older Printer Bot needs one (see UPDATING.md on GitHub). After the update, press Reload dock; Streamer.bot needs no restart.
